column1: # piece: Beethoven, Symphony No. 8 in F major, Op. 93, movement IV, Allegro vivace (F major), bars 0-130
# edition: Breitkopf & Härtel, Beethovens Werke Serie 1 No. 8 (IMSLP #61814), pdf <work>/dl/scores/b8.pdf
# page 45: system 1 bars 122-131 (transcribed to bar 130; spans tied over into 131 end at 131:3); system 2 not read
# time signature alla breve (cut time) throughout; beat unit = half note (beats 1-2; a quarter = 0.5, x:3 = end of bar x).
# Bar 0 = the half-bar upbeat (violins' triplets on 0:2); bar 1 = first full bar (the unison C-sharp ff falls in bar 17, as in the usual numbering).
# Scoring: 2 fl, 2 ob, 2 cl in B-flat (written key signature one sharp), 2 bsn, 2 hn in F, 2 tpt in F, timpani in F-C, strings.
# Voices: a staff with one line and a rest for the other voice is given to player 1 only; two-note chords / two stems to both.
# Horns and trumpets in bars 59-68 and 124-127 are written as single notes on each staff (unison/a2 not marked): given to both players, uncertain.
# Flutes in bars 17 and 105-107 are a single line without a second-voice rest: given to both, uncertain.
# Doubts: beat positions approximate to the nearest quarter (0.5 beat).
